metadata.description: Collection of Claude plugins for output styles, agents, and skills focused on development.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Strategic git commit plugin — semantic analysis, whole-file staging, hook-validated commits, native git hooks, and safety hooks

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Independent Codex-based code review of the current git diff. Provides the /codex-review skill which runs codex-review.sh and presents the verdict, summary, and findings.

plugins.name: session
plugins.description: Session lifecycle helpers for Claude Code. The /report skill writes a structured handoff report under .claude/sessions/ capturing the session contract, work completed, decisions, and fixed-numbered pending items, then commits the file in a single isolated subject-only chore: commit (opt out with --no-commit). The /recall skill retrieves, searches, and resumes prior reports via five subcommands (list, filter, grep, resume, last) so the next agent can pick up pending work without re-reading source code.

plugins.name: pragma
plugins.description: Standing working directives, injected as session context by a SessionStart hook rather than waiting to be invoked. Four rules: verify a disputed claim before conceding it and say when the user is wrong; treat a complaint as a question, not a request to build something; never present a dominated option as a live alternative; and never report a result that was not run, or work as done while a known inconsistency in it is open.
